hero.headline: Partner with a club building something real.
hero.sub: Sponsoring Titans is more than logo placement. It is an investment in youth development, leadership, and a growing cricket culture in New York.

whyPartner: New York Titans is a young club with a long ambition. We are building a serious community institution for cricket, character, and leadership in one of the most diverse cities in the world. Partnership with Titans means supporting that mission directly: standards on the field, character off it, and a credible home for players and families who care about the game.
communityImageAlt: Titans youth members volunteering together in the community.

themes.name: Founding
themes.description: For partners who want to be part of building Titans from the ground up. Visibility across the club and a long-term seat at the table.

themes.name: Community
themes.description: For partners aligned with our mission to serve neighborhoods and bring cricket to people who haven't yet found their way in.

themes.name: Youth Development
themes.description: For partners who want to invest directly in player development, mentoring, and pathways for young cricketers.

themes.name: Team Support
themes.description: For partners providing kit, training facilities, equipment, or in-kind services that help the club operate.
